# Preface {-}

These notes have been compiled for self study and to complement courses at the University of Exeter in Cornwall. They are a work in progress -- please get in touch if you find any errors or have any feedback.

Contact: m.callaway@exeter.ac.uk, t.h.hughes@exeter.ac.uk, e.h.branford@exeter.ac.uk

Recommended text: Engineering Mathematics, John Bird. Available online through the UoE library here: <https://encore.exeter.ac.uk/iii/encore/record/C__Rb4511752>


## Acknowledgements {-}

Thank you to our colleagues who have contributed to these notes by sharing lecture materials: Dr TJ McKinley, Dr Houry Melkonian, Dr Markus Mueller and Prof Stuart Townley.
